name: Research-grade Data Collector
summary: A portable acquisition device for Sycsense research-grade capacitive tactile sensors. It supports simultaneous multipoint acquisition, local data storage and user-configurable collection parameters. The manufacturer lists 24-bit precision and a 10 ms frame interval.
